annotations.title: Request a human attestation with evidence

description: Request that a human observes and attests an observable fact (with photos, timestamps and a signed statement). Not a notarisation. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

evidence_required.description: Optional: what evidence you need (photos, video, document copies).

fact_to_attest.description: The exact fact to observe and attest.

time_window.description: When the observation should take place.

name: request_attestation
